A smartphone is held in the foreground, showing a camera preview of the same scene.

A photo of the 'Settings > Storage' screen.

risks.risk: Installed games may be digital licenses tied to a personal account that will not be accessible to the buyer.
The optical disc drive may be faulty.
risks.proof: A video showing a disc being inserted and the game launching.
risks.if_unproven: as having a broken disc drive

risks.risk: The console may be banned from the PlayStation Network (PSN).
risks.proof: A video showing a successful login to the PlayStation Store.

proof_requests: Photo of the controller out of the box.
Photos of physical game discs if they are included.
Video showing the disc drive working and a successful PSN connection.
response.reason: The item is identifiable as a PS4 Slim. It can be priced at its worst-case configuration: 500GB storage, third-party controller, no games, and unproven disc drive/online status.
